title: FDA说安全：CEO却说影响还在，顾客恐惧何时能消？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We've seen the numbers from your most recent earnings report. We've seen the forecast for a contraction in same store sales.
segments.zh: 我们看到了你最新财报的数字，也看到了同店销售额收缩的预测。

segments.en: I am curious that since that report, have you seen any sort of improvement at all in foot traffic to your stores?
segments.zh: 我很好奇，自那之后，你看到门店客流量有任何改善吗？

segments.en: We'll remain first of all, great to be here with you.
Very fitting name for this interview. And I think we're all happy.
segments.zh: 这次采访的名字很贴切，我想我们都很高兴。

segments.en: Your name's not iceberg this month.
So yes, it was obviously cyclospora has had an impact on our business as it has had a business had an impact on really anyone selling fresh produce.
segments.zh: 是的，显然环孢子虫对我们的业务有影响，就像对任何销售新鲜农产品的人一样。

segments.en: The good news is just over the last week, the FDA has announced that it is safe to eat iceberg lettuce.
segments.zh: 好消息是，就在上周，FDA宣布食用冰山生菜是安全的。

segments.en: So as we mentioned on our earnings call, we had a really big initial impact.
segments.zh: 正如我们在财报电话会议上提到的，我们一开始受到了很大的影响。

segments.en: We have seen some recovery since, but it has been a significant impact given this fear customers have about having leafy greens.
segments.zh: 此后我们看到了一些恢复，但由于顾客对绿叶蔬菜的担忧，影响仍然很大。

segments.en: The important thing for sweet green though is that none of our customers or our supply chain has been implicated in the outbreak.
segments.zh: 对Sweetgreen来说，重要的是我们的客户或供应链都没有卷入这次疫情。

segments.en: We do not serve iceberg lettuce. The outbreak is been isolated to iceberg lettuce from Mexico, resource all of our greens from the United States.
segments.zh: 我们不供应卷心莴苣。疫情仅限于来自墨西哥的卷心莴苣，我们的所有生菜都来自美国。

segments.en: And a lot of ways this is a moment where the sweet green supply chain and the direct relationships with farmers is so critically important.
segments.zh: 在很多方面，这是甜绿供应链以及与农民直接关系至关重要的时刻。

segments.en: Well, before we get deeper into that, have you had any sort of contact or any of your folks there with the government?
segments.zh: 在我们深入探讨之前，您或您的团队是否与政府有过任何接触？

segments.en: We had the former FDA deputy director, excuse me, for the CDC's national center for infectious diseases.
segments.zh: 我们曾邀请前FDA副局长，抱歉，是CDC国家传染病中心的前副主任。
